checks.name: C1 [negative control: changed vacuum prediction under Y_ref variation] with the SAME static kernel J'=mu_2, moving the boundary from 1e-4 to 100 changes J(0) monotonically and strictly (dG0/dlam = (lam^2+2lam)/(1+lam)^2 > 0), so the vacuum prediction is a continuous one-parameter family, not a determined constant
checks.measured: monotone-strict: True, distinct values: True; ranges J(0) in [-1e-8 ... -99.0]
checks.reading: the control is capable of failing: had the zero mode been removed WITHOUT residue, every Y_ref would give the same J(0)/vacuum prediction; they differ at every sampled reference. The freedom is relocated to Y_ref, not removed: one real dimensionless datum enters, fixed by no equation of the action (consistent with k01's no-second-scale theorem).
